reasons.plausibility: Hf-doping is well-documented to improve oxide scale adhesion in similar high-temperature coatings, making this proposal scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis includes a clear side-by-side cyclic oxidation test with quantifiable pass/fail criteria, so the outcome would decisively confirm or refute it.
reasons.usefulness: It extends a known reactive-element strategy specifically to high-entropy alloy bond coats, offering a direct, actionable pathway to improve TBC durability.
